notes: Hyper-parameters N, T, s, max included literals, epochs and Table I literal-sampling value are not reported; N, T, s were 'initially optimized for each dataset' (Sec. V-B) with only predefined train/test splits mentioned and no validation set, but the paper does not say what data the optimization used, so selection_on_test is not_reported. Tables I/II report accuracy (training time in seconds) 'from last 25 epochs'; whether this is an average over the last 25 epochs (average_last_epochs) or something else, and whether time is per epoch or total, is not stated, so statistic is not_reported. Fig. 6-8 (R8, 150 epochs: test accuracy, training time, absorbing rate per epoch) are figures only, not extracted. Sec. V-C text says 'two datasets showed improved accuracy with absorbing state 70', but Table I has no state 70 (states 0/25/50/75/100/125); likely a typo for 75. Table II R8 baseline (state 0) differs from Table I R8 (95.37), so Table I used some unreported literal-sampling setting. MPQA, CR and SUBJ have no widely used official split, yet the paper says predefined train/test splits were used for all datasets; recorded as 'official' per the paper. n_states=128 and state_bits=8 are inferred from the 256-state TA described in Sec. III-A/IV-A and the 'two states away from the center' remark for state 125.
